plain_description: SillyTavern is a single, powerful interface that lets you chat with any major AI model, generate images, and add voice to conversations — all without switching between tools. It runs entirely on your own machine, keeping your data private and giving you full control over how you use AI. The bottom line: one app, every leading AI provider, no cloud lock-in.
technical_description: SillyTavern is a self-hosted, web-based frontend application that provides a unified interface for interacting with large language models (LLMs), image generation engines, and text-to-speech services. Built on Node.js 20+, it serves a responsive HTML/JavaScript client with backend connectors for KoboldAI, KoboldCPP, Horde, NovelAI, Ooba, Tabby, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic Claude, and Mistral. The application includes a plugin-based extension system, lorebook (WorldInfo) management, auto-translation, Visual Novel Mode, and integration with Automatic1111 and ComfyUI for image generation. It can be deployed via Docker or installed directly on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android (Termux).
title: SillyTavern
